applies_to: supplementary mixed-v1, after primary campaign releases the shared lock
purpose: Measure peak memory when the same persistent SDK has loaded both image and video engines; confirm one live Node process across all three profile choices
schedule: Seven marks, three positive checks, one clean negative; first image/first video engine explicitly labelled, not conflated with fully warm model state
measurement: Exact frozen main-v1 observer and worker, same image/limits/corpus/credentials; no SDK modification
interpretation: Separate supplementary control, not pooled into primary cold/warm medians or treated as a load/SLA test
